endif()

endif()
foreach(File ${ConfigFiles})
    get_filename_component(FileBase ${File} NAME_WE)
    add_custom_command(
            TARGET platform POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
                    ${File}
                    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${FileBase}.properties)
endforeach()
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Pinfo)
    file(COPY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Pinfo DESTINATION ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)
endif()

    file(COPY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/multi-nodes.py DESTINATION ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin FILE_PERMISSIONS OWNER_EXECUTE OWNER_WRITE OWNER_READ)
endif()
